responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s mutable program-state payload layered on top of region_model plus checker-specific state maps. This file defines extrinsic_state for shared checker metadata, sm_state_map for sparse svalue-to-state tracking with origins and leak/liveness handling, and program_state operations for copying, hashing, printing, stack/call transitions, edge handling, purging, merging, leak detection, and replay of call summaries across the combined memory and checker-state domains.
same_name_distinction: Implements the concrete behavior of extrinsic_state, sm_state_map, and program_state declared in program-state.h, including state hashing/printing, state-machine map maintenance, call and edge transitions, merging, purging, leak handling, and selftests.
